name: zdi_add_polygon_split_by_vertex_limit
description: zDi::AddPolygonSplitByVertexLimit emits anchored overlapping polygon chunks through zDi::AddPolygonEx when a polygon exceeds the accepted vertex-count chunk size.
known_limits: This helper recursively calls zDi::AddPolygonEx. Functional acceptance is limited to the chunk staging path covered by the native smoke; full tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x483240 validates the fastcall ABI with self in ecx, totalVertexCount in edx, and points, entryNormals, uvPairsA, normalsA, normalsBInput, uvPairsBInput, material, drawFlags, flagBit8, userTag, and maxChunkVertexCount on the stack.

Binary Ninja assembly validates clamping maxChunkVertexCount to 4, anchoring each emitted chunk at vertex 0, advancing chunkStartVertexIndex by vertexCount - 2, staging optional entry normals and secondary UVs, and calling zDi::AddPolygonEx for each chunk.
The native smoke verifies a six-vertex polygon emits two four-vertex entries with expected anchored chunk point and UV staging through the production zDi::AddPolygonEx path.
